metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Regimes (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Nominal • Harmonic • Resolution
metadata.description: Defines the canonical regime structure for FFT AI Edition v1.3, including measure thresholds, paradox rules, consent rules, substrate constraints, and RTT alignment.

status_line: Regimes define the operational state of the AI Edition and govern RTT transitions, paradox handling, consent, and collapse.

nominal.description: Stable coherence, bounded drift, no paradox.
nominal.notes: Nominal regime corresponds to frozen RTT diffusion → alignment → coupling → activation → triadic time → S–N–R.

harmonic.description: Paradox present; harmonic escalation possible with consent.
harmonic.notes: Harmonic regime corresponds to frozen RTT stabilization → resonance envelope.

resolution.collapse_rule: RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
resolution.notes: Resolution regime corresponds to frozen RTT apex → rewind → collapse.

consent_rules.aa3_escalation: operator_consent = true required for RTT9 → RTT10
consent_rules.refusal: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused and logged.

continuity_rules.notes: Continuity MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.

non_claims: Regimes do not revise RTT v0.9.
Regimes do not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Regimes do not replace the human FFT book.
